summary: iter313 P0 — Save as Draft full E2E re-verification across 5 wizards + Drafts dashboard. After portal-mount fix (z-[90] floating button at top-right of viewport), Marketplace, Lots and Storage wizards ALL pass: POST /api/drafts/save fires and returns 200 with draft_id, toast renders. Idempotency confirmed (2 clicks on Marketplace = 1 draft in DB). Drafts dashboard sub-tab renders Storage/Lots/Marketplace type badges + Resume + Delete; Resume hydrates URL with ?draft_id=. Delete loop wipes all drafts and 'No saved drafts yet.' empty state appears. Vehicle (FEATURE 4) and Multi-Lot Vehicle (FEATURE 5) STILL FAIL — different root cause than iter257: /vehicle-auctions/create now hard-redirects testdealer@bidvex.com to /vehicle-auctions/seller/register with toast 'Please register as a vehicle seller first', and /vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create returns 404 'Page non trouvée'. The dealer-gate is checking a vehicle_sellers collection record (NOT the user-level is_vehicle_dealer flag from the seed), and the multi-lot route appears broken or behind a separate gate.

ui_bugs.issue: testdealer@bidvex.com (seeded with is_vehicle_dealer=True, vehicle_dealer_verified=True) is HARD-REDIRECTED to /vehicle-auctions/seller/register with red toast 'Please register as a vehicle seller first'. The dealer-gate is reading a record from the vehicle_sellers collection (likely vehicle_sellers.verification_status='approved') rather than the user-level flags from /api/auth/me. As a result, the SaveAsDraftButton never enters the DOM and FEATURE 4 cannot be exercised. Either (a) seed a vehicle_sellers approved record for testdealer, or (b) move SaveAsDraftButton above the dealer-gate redirect so partial drafts are allowed pre-onboarding, or (c) fix the gate to honour user.is_vehicle_dealer+vehicle_dealer_verified.

Route returns 404 'Page non trouvée / Enchère introuvable' for testdealer. URL did NOT redirect to /seller/register — it loaded a generic 404 page (likely a child route inside /vehicle-auctions/:slug catches first and tries to fetch a listing with id='multi-lot'). The route either is not declared in App.js or is shadowed by a dynamic detail route. data-testid='save-as-draft-btn-multi_lot_vehicle' is not in DOM. Verify route registration in /app/frontend/src/App.js and route precedence (static /multi-lot/create must come BEFORE any /vehicle-auctions/:id pattern).

issues: Cookie Consent dialog reappears on the dashboard despite localStorage.bidvex_cookie_consent being set — banner is non-blocking but visually overlaps drafts list. Same issue noted in iter257.

verified_passing: FEATURE 1 Marketplace: POST /api/drafts/save returned 200 on click; second click on same session updated the SAME draft (DB shows exactly 1 draft 'TEST_Marketplace_Draft' for marketplace type — idempotency CONFIRMED). Toast 'Draft saved (expires in 30 days).' shown.
FEATURE 2 Lots: POST /api/drafts/save returned 200 with draft_id. Draft 'TEST_Lots_Event' (type=lots) verified in /api/drafts listing.
FEATURE 3 Storage: POST /api/drafts/save returned 200. Storage badge + '(untitled draft)' tile visible on Drafts tab.

FEATURE 6 Unified Drafts sub-tab: data-testid='tab-drafts' clickable, [data-testid='seller-drafts-tab'] renders 3 cards (Storage Auction badge, Lots/Multi-Item badge, Marketplace badge), 30d-left expiry pill, Resume + Delete buttons per row.
FEATURE 7 Resume Draft: click [data-testid='edit-draft-<id>'] navigates to wizard URL with ?draft_id=<id> (verified for storage route -> /storage-auctions/create?draft_id=...).
FEATURE 8 Delete Draft: 3 DELETE /api/drafts/<id> requests returned 200, cards removed from list, 'Draft deleted' toast shown.
FEATURE 9 Empty state: [data-testid='seller-drafts-empty'] 'No saved drafts yet.' renders after last draft deleted.

Portal mount: SaveAsDraftButton renders via React portal at document.body with position:fixed top-20 right-4 z-[90] — clicks fire through above the TaxInterviewModal overlay (iter257 root cause is FIXED for marketplace and lots).
not_tested: FEATURE 4 Vehicle Save as Draft — page redirects testdealer to /vehicle-auctions/seller/register; button never in DOM.
FEATURE 5 Multi-Lot Vehicle Save as Draft — route returns 404; button never in DOM.
FEATURE 10 Restore Expired Draft — explicitly skip-able per request; not exercised.
action_items: Vehicle gate: align /vehicle-auctions/create access for testdealer@bidvex.com. Either seed an approved vehicle_sellers collection record for the testdealer user (preferred — matches production gate), OR move SaveAsDraftButton to render BEFORE the redirect so partial drafts are allowed for users who haven't yet completed the vehicle-seller onboarding.

Fix /vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create routing — currently returns 404. Verify the route is declared in /app/frontend/src/App.js and that it is registered BEFORE any /vehicle-auctions/:id catch-all dynamic route.

Once both vehicle pages render the SaveAsDraftButton, re-test FEATURES 4 and 5 to confirm the portal-mounted button also fires POST /api/drafts/save and returns 200 for type='vehicle' and type='multi_lot_vehicle'.
Cookie Consent: investigate why bidvex_cookie_consent localStorage flag isn't suppressing the banner on /seller/dashboard (banner re-appears in both EN and FR variants).
critical_code_review_comments: SaveAsDraftButton portal fix is correct and effective — it correctly escapes TaxInterviewModal's stacking context (z-[70]) by mounting on document.body with z-[90]. Idempotency via draftId prop also works (2 clicks => 1 draft).

Vehicle dealer-gate logic is inconsistent with the seeded test credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md states testdealer has is_vehicle_dealer=True + vehicle_dealer_verified=True, but the gate at /vehicle-auctions/create reads vehicle_sellers collection state. Either the seed script needs to also create the vehicle_sellers record, or the gate needs to honour both signals.

/vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create returning a 404 'Page non trouvée' page (and not the SellerRegister redirect) indicates the route is either unregistered or order-shadowed by another dynamic route. This needs immediate router audit.
SellerDashboard.js still 1100+ lines — extract per-tab components (already noted in iter257).

Stale-handle issue when iterating delete-draft buttons in a loop: each delete removes the row, so previously-collected handles detach. Tests should re-query after every click (handled in the loop now).

success_rate.frontend: Features 1,2,3,6,7,8,9 = 7/10 verified PASS (~70%). Features 4 and 5 BLOCKED on dealer-gate + 404 routing. Feature 10 not in scope.

test_credentials: testseller@bidvex.com / TestSeller2026! (login verified); testdealer@bidvex.com / TestDealer2026! (login verified, but vehicle-create route redirects to /seller/register).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 drafts during run (marketplace, lots, storage) and then deleted all 3 via the UI — DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketplace/Lots/Storage Save-as-Draft + Drafts dashboard sub-tab + Resume + Delete + Empty state are all confirmed working — the portal-mount z-[90] fix solved the iter257 overlay block. Outstanding work is Vehicle + Multi-Lot Vehicle only. For FEATURE 4, the testdealer account needs either a seeded approved vehicle_sellers record OR the dealer-gate needs to honour the user-level is_vehicle_dealer flag; the SaveAsDraftButton itself is healthy (proved by 3 other wizards). For FEATURE 5, /vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create is currently 404 — likely a route-registration bug in App.js. After main agent fixes both, only those 2 features need re-running.
rca of the issue: iter257 root cause (TaxInterviewModal z-[70] overlay swallowing clicks on /create-listing and /create-multi-item-listing) is RESOLVED by the portal mount + z-[90] fix — marketplace and lots now fire POST /api/drafts/save successfully. Remaining 2 failures are unrelated: (a) testdealer is redirected away from /vehicle-auctions/create because the dealer-gate looks at vehicle_sellers collection state instead of the user-level is_vehicle_dealer/vehicle_dealer_verified flags from /api/auth/me, and (b) /vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create returns a 404 page entirely (route not registered or shadowed). Idempotency (1 draft per type per session) and the universal SaveAsDraftButton component itself are both confirmed correct.
